Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
 Your Role
 As a Junior ServiceNow Developer French speaker with Capgemini, you will contribute to the configuration, development, testing, and deployment of AI-powered solutions on the ServiceNow platform under the guidance of experienced developers and architects. You will strengthen your core ServiceNow skills while gaining experience with Now Assist, AI Agents, integrations, and enterprise AI use cases.
 In This Role You Will
 Configure and develop ServiceNow applications and workflows.
 Support the implementation of Now Assist use cases and AI-powered automations.
 Configure prompts, AI skills, and simple AI Agent capabilities.
 Develop and maintain integrations using REST APIs with support from senior team members.
 Participate in testing, debugging, defect resolution, and quality-assurance activities.
 Produce technical documentation and development deliverables.
 Support workshops, customer demonstrations, proofs of concept, and internal AI showcases.
 Participate in hackathons and AI Factory innovation initiatives.
 Assist in building demonstration environments and accelerators.
 Contribute to reusable assets and knowledge repositories while continuously developing ServiceNow and AI skills.
 Your Profile
 1–2 years of relevant ServiceNow experience for this recruitment need.
 Foundational ServiceNow development knowledge and a strong interest in AI-powered enterprise solutions.
 Basic to intermediate JavaScript knowledge.
 Familiarity with REST APIs, Flow Designer, workflows, testing, and debugging.
 Exposure to Now Assist, prompts, AI skills, or AI Agents is valued.
 Professional fluency in French and English.
 Preferred certifications: CSA and CAD.
 Strong learning ability, rigor, communication, teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 What You Will Love About Working Here
Software Engineer Community: Join a global community of 100,000+ software engineering professionals and expand your network through client and executive interactions.
Diverse & Impactful Projects: Develop your expertise across a wide range of missions, technologies, and sectors, with meaningful autonomy and room for initiative.
Continuous Learning: Access comprehensive training platforms and recognized certifications.
Flexibility & Balance: Benefit from hybrid working policies that allow you to manage your time and work location effectively.
